claims.statement: FilesystemMiddleware and SubAgentMiddleware are protected Deep Agents scaffolding because they respectively enforce built-in filesystem permissions and implement the task tool; excluding either through a harness profile raises instead of producing a degraded graph.

create_deep_agent resolves the model profile and backend, assembles subagent and middleware behavior, delegates the result to LangChain create_agent, and uses a DeltaChannel-backed messages state to keep checkpoint growth linear.

Deep Agents inserts novel caller middleware after its core stack and before the tail, replaces same-named stack entries in place, and applies profile tool exclusion last so custom middleware cannot restore an excluded tool.

SubAgentMiddleware exposes the blocking task bridge for declarative and compiled subagents: isolated children receive a delegated description, forks receive effective summarized parent history, and completed children return one ToolMessage while private, excluded, and unchanged inherited state is withheld from the parent update.

AsyncSubAgentMiddleware runs remote Agent Protocol work without blocking the parent by persisting a local async_tasks record on launch and exposing start, check, update, cancel, and list tools; remote execution and its thread remain owned by the remote graph.

Remote async task updates create an interrupting run on the existing thread and replace the tracked run ID; task checks map a successfully finished but interrupted remote thread to waiting, while cancellation of a waiting task is recorded locally because no active run exists to cancel.

Deep Agents summarization preserves raw messages while recording a private event that reconstructs the compacted request, persists a session ID for append-only backend history, and continues with a warning when history offload fails; its factory selects fraction-based defaults from max_input_tokens or fixed fallback defaults and requires a resolved BaseChatModel.

Talon's DeepAgentRuntime is an integration caller of the SDK builder: it prepares Talon-specific tools, approvals, middleware, backend, and checkpointing, then invokes create_deep_agent, including a replacement filesystem middleware and selected-model summarization layer.

The top-level deepagents package is the curated consumer import surface for graph construction/state, filesystem and subagent types, selected middleware, profiles, and profile registration, while deepagents.middleware exposes the middleware-facing feature types.

dcode's DeepAgentsApp owns the Textual terminal application boundary, including app-level interaction bindings and the background-server success and failure messages used to hand a constructed agent to the UI.

Talon MCP OAuth stores credentials in server-identity-scoped owner-only files and preserves a previous refresh token on refresh responses that omit it; its OAuth transport is HTTPS-only, SSRF-safe, and rejects redirects and unsafe discovered endpoints.

The lockfile pre-commit check selects packages touched by changed paths, checks them with each package's required Python version, and computes changed manifests' transitive local consumers through tool.uv.sources paths.

ContextHubBackend lazily snapshots a LangSmith Hub agent repository, treats a missing repository as empty, overlays accepted pending and in-flight mutations on reads, and batches writes before their callers return after remote durability.

On a Context Hub commit conflict, ContextHubBackend reloads the remote tree and rematerializes queued edits or deletes from their original intents before retrying; incompatible rematerialization settles affected callers with the conflict.

dcode's cli_main keeps lightweight version and help paths ahead of heavy bootstrap, gates policy-sensitive commands on healthy managed configuration, and validates a managed sandbox default against SandboxRegistry before accepting it for the launch.

SandboxRegistry merges built-in, entry-point, and configuration-declared sandbox providers, resolving collisions in configuration, entry-point, then built-in precedence; provider construction follows the same order.

TalonHost starts its agent before channels and scheduler, unwinds partially started components in reverse order on failure, and on shutdown cancels work before stopping channels in reverse order, then scheduler and agent.

TalonHost serializes inbound work with provider/chat history locks and per-conversation locks, handles commands, approvals, and authorization interception before replacing an agent turn, and drops stale-generation results rather than delivering them to a superseding turn.

DiscordChannel rejects self-authored Gateway messages, applies guild addressing and exposure or pairing admission before thread creation or media download, and dispatches admitted events to the host as provider-neutral ChannelMessage values.

Discord application commands are converted to the same textual command path as typed commands, deferred before dispatch, and their replies use a task-local interaction sink so unrelated work cannot be captured by the invocation.

CompositeBackend routes file operations by longest matching prefix, exposes virtual route directories at the root, remaps routed search and listing paths, and reserves command execution for a sandbox-capable default backend.

dcode create_sandbox validates provider snapshot capability and ownership, runs optional setup after acquisition, and cleans up only sandboxes it created even when setup or the context body fails; cleanup errors do not replace the original failure.

StateBackend stores per-thread files in LangGraph's files channel and uses CONFIG_KEY_READ with fresh reads plus CONFIG_KEY_SEND partial updates, providing read-your-writes within a superstep while requiring graph execution context.

StoreBackend provides persistent cross-thread files scoped by a validated caller namespace; it rejects unsafe namespace components and can use an explicit store outside a graph only when the namespace factory does not require the runtime.

The State and Store backends preserve compatibility with legacy list-of-string file content by normalizing it for reads without mutating storage, while subsequent writes or edits persist string content, preserve creation metadata, and retain binary upload/download round trips through base64.

Shared backend utilities clamp model-supplied read windows and return pagination metadata, and implement literal grep that skips base64 files and returns invalid glob filters as result errors rather than raising.

TalonConfig validates and namespaces each assistant's runtime state, creates its home and child directories with restrictive permissions, initializes approval storage, and constrains interim-message verbosity to levels 1 through 3.

Talon progress delivery is invocation-local: ContextVars scope the channel handler and shared verbosity budget, ProgressMessages forwards qualifying main-agent tool narration before execution, and explicit message delivery reports channel, validation, budget, and transport failures without exposing transport details.

DeepAgentRuntime snapshots tool-approval policy into the constructed graph and invocation context, rebuilds on a changed persisted snapshot, and resolves approval interrupts through the request handler while automatically rejecting cron, background-delivery, and handler-less requests.
